# Mirabel Cotton & Tommy

- [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) — Sibling of — [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) — brother · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Rebellious against Mrs. Lynde's rules, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerces [Dora](../character/dora.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, he lies to Mrs. Lynde to cover up his behavior, but he is tormented by guilt until [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home that night and listens to his confession.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors
